Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. OEM IMPORTED PRODUCTS: In case of imported products, OEM or Authorized Seller of OEM should have a registered office in India to provide after sales service support in India. The certificate to this effect should be submitted. 4. Certificates ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification. 5. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the

Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 6. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 7. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses The bidder/seller shall provide the following documents 1. Copy of Aadhar Card 2. Copy of PAN Card 3. Copy of GST Registration Certificate 4. Copy of Work Declaration Certificate 5. Copy of Income tax Documents 6. Certificate regarding acceptation of all T&C 7. Undertaking regarding non-blacklisting 8. Copy of MSME & MII certificate 9. Copy of last 3 years ITR 10. Copy of Annual turnover of last 3 years 11. Copy of similar work experience. ADDITIONAL TERMS & CONDITIONS (ATC) 1. Scope of Supply: The scope of supply shall include supply and delivery of plumbing materials, water supply pipes, pip e fittings, valves, connectors and other related items as specified in the GeM Bid. 2. Genuine & New Material: All materials shall be brand new, unused, genuine and free from manufacturing defects. Used, refur bished, repaired, recycled or damaged materials shall not be accepted. 3. Technical Specification: The supplied materials shall strictly conform to the size, material, class, pressure rating, thickness, t ype and other technical specifications mentioned in the GeM Bid. 4. Suitable for Water Supply: All pipes and fittings shall be suitable for the intended water supply/plumbing application and shall be capable of withstanding the applicable working pressure and normal operating conditions. 5. Compatibility: Pipe fittings such as elbows, tees, sockets, reducers, unions, nipples, couplers, valves and connector s shall be fully compatible with the corresponding pipe material, size and connection system. 6. Leak-Proof Requirement: All supplied pipes and fittings shall provide proper and leak-proof connections. The material shall no t develop leakage, cracks or deformation under normal operating conditions. 7. BIS/IS Standards: Wherever applicable, the supplied materials shall conform to the relevant BIS/IS standards and sh all bear the required BIS/ISI marking. 8. Material Quality: PVC/UPVC/CPVC and other plastic pipes/fittings shall be manufactured from suitable quality material and shall be free from cracks, pinholes, blisters, warping, surface defects and other manuf acturing defects. 9. Pressure Rating: Pipes and fittings shall have a suitable pressure rating corresponding to the intended application. T he pressure/class of the supplied material shall not be lower than that specified in the GeM Bid. 10. Size & Dimensions:

The nominal size, outside diameter, wall thickness, thread size and other dimensions shall conform t o the specifications mentioned in the GeM Bid and applicable standards. 11. Threaded Fittings: Threaded fittings shall have properly formed, clean and uniform threads suitable for leak-proof conn ection with the corresponding fittings/pipes. 12. Valves: Valves supplied under the bid shall be suitable for the specified water supply application, shall oper ate smoothly and shall provide proper shut-off without leakage under normal operating conditions. 13. Clamps & Supports: Pipe clamps, brackets and supports, wherever included in the bid, shall be of suitable size and stren gth for securely fixing the corresponding pipe. 14. Jointing Accessories: Necessary jointing accessories such as compatible washers, seals, O-rings, nuts, bolts or other com ponents shall be supplied wherever specifically included in the specification. 15. Make/Brand: Where a specific make/brand is mentioned in the GeM Bid, the seller shall supply the specified make /brand, subject to applicable GeM provisions. No change in make/brand/model shall be made withou t prior approval of the Competent Authority. 16. Inspection & Acceptance: The supplied materials shall be subject to inspection by the consignee/authorized representative. A cceptance shall be based on conformity with the specified size, quality, quantity, material and tech nical requirements. 17. Testing: Where applicable, the purchaser may conduct or arrange suitable inspection/testing of the supplied materials. Any material failing to meet the prescribed requirements shall be rejected. 18. Replacement of Defective Material: Any defective, damaged, cracked, deformed, leaking or non-conforming material noticed at the time of inspection or during the applicable warranty period shall be replaced by the seller free of cost. 19. Warranty: Wherever applicable, the supplied materials shall carry the manufacturer's standard warranty or the warranty specified in the GeM Bid, whichever is applicable. 20. Documents to be Provided by Seller: The successful bidder/seller shall provide the following documents, wherever applicable: Manufacturer's Technical Datasheet/Catalogue. BIS/ISI Certificate/License. Test/Quality Certificate. Manufacturer's Warranty Certificate. Product Make, Model, Size and Specification details. OEM Authorization, wherever specifically required. GST Tax Invoice. Any other document required under the GeM Bid/technical specification. 21. Packing: All materials shall be properly packed to prevent damage, deformation, contamination or loss durin g transportation and handling. 22. Transportation: The seller shall be responsible for safe transportation and delivery of the material at the designated consignee location. Any material damaged during transit shall be replaced by the seller at his own c ost. 23. No Substitution: The seller shall not substitute any specified pipe, fitting, valve or other material with another size, t ype, material, class or make without prior written approval of the Competent Authority. 24. Quantity: Supply shall be made strictly as per the quantity ordered in the GeM Contract. No excess quantity s hall be supplied without prior authorization. 25. Price: The quoted price shall include all costs required for complete delivery at the consignee location, inc luding packing, forwarding, transportation, loading/unloading and other incidental charges, except t axes/duties required to be quoted separately in the GeM Bid. 26. Non-Blacklisting Undertaking: The bidder shall submit an undertaking declaring that the firm/company has not been blacklisted/de barred by any Central Government Department, State Government Department, PSU, Autonomous Body or Government organization as on the date of submission of the bid. 27. Compliance with Statutory Requirements: The seller shall comply with all applicable statutory rules, regulations, standards and safety require

ments relating to the supply of plumbing and water supply materials. 28. Rejection of Material: The purchaser reserves the right to reject any material which is defective, damaged, sub-standard, counterfeit, used, refurbished or does not conform to the prescribed specifications, standards, size, quantity or quality requirements. 29. Risk & Cost: In case of failure to supply conforming material within the stipulated delivery period or failure to rep lace rejected/defective material, necessary action shall be taken as per applicable GeM/Governmen t procurement terms and conditions. 30. Verification of Documents: The purchaser reserves the right to verify the authenticity of BIS/ISI certificates, manufacturer's cert ificates, test reports, warranty documents and other documents submitted by the bidder/seller. 31. Performance: All supplied plumbing materials and fittings shall perform satisfactorily under normal operating con ditions and shall be suitable for the intended water supply application. 32. GeM/Government Rules: The procurement shall be governed by the applicable GeM General Terms & Conditions (GTC), Bid Conditions and prevailing Government procurement rules. In case of any inconsistency, t he applicable GeM provisions and Government procurement rules shall prevail. .
